scope: Exactly one charged fermion of each species converts to a selected two-photon scalar or three-photon vector mode; all other occupations and raw-code complements are spectators.
energy_convention: Declared resonant free labels: each fermion mode has M/2 and each selected photon output has total M. Checks use M=3, above all tested coupling magnitudes, so the finite total-energy trial is positive; no native scale or wavepacket is selected.
symmetry_convention: CAR and a linear species flip fixing the vacuum derive minus-swap on the neutral ordered pair in this extension, not in the original source. Photon C parity is imported.
